what: BREAKR turns the FM-1 into a breakbeat machine for breakbeat, breakcore and IDM: slice any loop on its hits, sequence it on 64 steps with ratchets up to x16, trig conditions and effect locks, play 32 glitch effects (K-GLITCH's DESTROY and BEAT banks), 11 punch effects and 16 flex patterns, generate drill, breakcore and IDM patterns, and resample the output into new breaks right on the FM-1. Your own breaks go in from the browser, computer or Android phone.
